spec.title: 1-1. 플랫폼별 세션 비중 (Session Share by Platform)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    multiIf(
      lower(platform) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb'), '웹',
      lower(platform) = 'ios', 'IOS',
      lower(platform) IN ('aos', 'android'), 'AOS',
      '기타'
    ) AS platform_group,
    session_id
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(server_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
),
platform_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    platform_group,
    countDistinct(session_id) AS sessions
  FROM base
  WHERE platform_group IN ('웹', 'IOS', 'AOS')
  GROUP BY platform_group
),
total AS (
  SELECT sum(sessions) AS total_sessions
  FROM platform_sessions
)
SELECT
  platform,
  sessions,
  round(sessions / nullIf(total_sessions, 0) * 100, 2) AS session_percent
FROM
(
  SELECT
    platform_group AS platform,
    sessions,
    total_sessions
  FROM platform_sessions
  CROSS JOIN total

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    '전체' AS platform,
    total_sessions AS sessions,
    total_sessions
  FROM total
)
ORDER BY
  multiIf(platform = '전체', 0, platform = '웹', 1, platform = 'IOS', 2, platform = 'AOS', 3, 4);

spec.title: 5-1. 플랫폼·기기 환경별 세션 분포 (Platform & Device Environment)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    multiIf(
      lower(platform) = 'ios' AND lower(device_type) = 'mobile', 'IOS 모바일',
      lower(platform) = 'ios' AND lower(device_type) = 'tablet', 'IOS 태블릿',
      lower(platform) = 'ios' AND lower(device_type) = '', 'IOS',

      lower(platform) IN ('aos', 'android') AND lower(device_type) = 'mobile', 'AOS 모바일',
      lower(platform) IN ('aos', 'android') AND lower(device_type) = 'tablet', 'AOS 태블릿',
      lower(platform) IN ('aos', 'android') AND lower(device_type) = 'desktop', 'AOS 데스크톱',
      lower(platform) IN ('aos', 'android') AND lower(device_type) = '', 'AOS',

      lower(platform) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb') AND lower(device_type) = 'desktop', '웹 데스크톱',
      lower(platform) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb') AND lower(device_type) = 'mobile', '웹 모바일',
      lower(platform) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb') AND lower(device_type) = 'tablet', '웹 태블릿',
      lower(platform) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb') AND lower(device_type) = '', '웹',

      concat(ifNull(platform, ''), ' ', ifNull(device_type, ''))
    ) AS device_group,

    ifNull(os_type, '-') AS os_name,
    ifNull(browser, '-') AS browser_name,
    ifNull(app_version, '-') AS app_version_name,

    session_id

  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND platform != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
),

environment_summary AS (
  SELECT
    concat(
      device_group,
      multiIf(os_name != '-', concat(' / ', os_name), ''),
      multiIf(browser_name != '-', concat(' / ', browser_name), ''),
      multiIf(app_version_name != '-', concat(' / 앱 ', app_version_name), '')
    ) AS environment_name,

    countDistinct(session_id) AS session_count

  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    device_group,
    os_name,
    browser_name,
    app_version_name
),

total AS (
  SELECT
    sum(session_count) AS total_sessions
  FROM environment_summary
)

SELECT
  environment_name AS `환경 구분`,
  session_count AS `세션 수`,
  round(session_count / nullIf(total_sessions, 0) * 100, 2) AS `세션 비중(%)`
FROM environment_summary
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY
  `세션 수` DESC;

spec.title: 3-3. 페이지별 스크롤 탐색 깊이(Pages by Scroll Engagement)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
page_scroll_base AS (
  SELECT
    if(page_title = '', event_name, page_title) AS page_title_name,
    max(page_url) AS representative_page_url,

    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS total_views,

    countIf(
      event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
      AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
    ) AS scroll_event_count,

    countDistinctIf(
      session_id,
      event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
    ) AS view_sessions,

    countDistinctIf(
      session_id,
      event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
      AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
    ) AS scroll_sessions,

    round(
      countDistinctIf(
        session_id,
        event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
        AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
      )
      / nullIf(
          countDistinctIf(
            session_id,
            event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
          ),
          0
        )
      * 100,
      2
    ) AS scroll_session_rate,

    round(
      avgIf(
        scroll_depth_pct,
        event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
        AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
      ),
      2
    ) AS avg_scroll_depth,

    quantileIf(0.5)(
      scroll_depth_pct,
      event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
      AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
    ) AS median_scroll_depth,

    countDistinctIf(
      session_id,
      event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
      AND scroll_depth_pct >= 70
    ) AS deep_scroll_sessions,

    round(
      countDistinctIf(
        session_id,
        event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
        AND scroll_depth_pct >= 70
      )
      / nullIf(
          countDistinctIf(
            session_id,
            event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
            AND scroll_depth_pct > 1
          ),
          0
        )
      * 100,
      2
    ) AS deep_scroll_rate
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND page_url != ''
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY page_title_name
),

ordered_pages AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM page_scroll_base
  WHERE total_views > 0
  ORDER BY
    total_views DESC
)

SELECT
  rowNumberInAllBlocks() + 1 AS `순번`,
  page_title_name AS `페이지 제목`,
  representative_page_url AS `페이지 URL`,
  total_views AS `전체 조회수`,
  scroll_event_count AS `스크롤 발생 이벤트 수`,
  view_sessions AS `조회 세션 수`,
  scroll_sessions AS `스크롤 세션 수`,
  scroll_session_rate AS `스크롤 발생 세션 비율`,
  avg_scroll_depth AS `평균 스크롤 깊이`,
  median_scroll_depth AS `중앙값 스크롤 깊이`,
  deep_scroll_sessions AS `깊은 탐색 세션 수`,
  deep_scroll_rate AS `깊은 탐색 비율`
FROM ordered_pages;

spec.title: 1-6. 체류시간 기준 초과/이하 세션 비중 (Session Duration Above/Below Benchmark)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
session_durations AS (
  SELECT
    argMax(user_id, client_ts) AS session_user_id,
    session_id,
    multiIf(
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb'), '웹',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) = 'ios', 'IOS',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('aos', 'android'), 'AOS',
      '기타'
    ) AS platform_group,
    dateDiff('second', min(client_ts), max(client_ts)) AS duration_sec
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY session_id
),

filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM session_durations
  WHERE platform_group IN ('웹', 'IOS', 'AOS')
    AND duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 10800
),

global_stats AS (
  SELECT
    avg(duration_sec) AS global_mean_sec,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_sec) AS global_median_sec
  FROM filtered
)

SELECT
  `플랫폼`,
  `평균 초과 세션 수`,
  `평균 초과 비율(%)`,
  `평균 이하 세션 수`,
  `중앙값 초과 세션 수`,
  `중앙값 초과 비율(%)`,
  `중앙값 이하 세션 수`
FROM
(
  SELECT
    platform AS `플랫폼`,

    over_mean_count AS `평균 초과 세션 수`,
    round(over_mean_count / nullIf(total_sessions, 0) * 100, 2) AS `평균 초과 비율(%)`,
    under_or_equal_mean_count AS `평균 이하 세션 수`,

    over_median_count AS `중앙값 초과 세션 수`,
    round(over_median_count / nullIf(total_sessions, 0) * 100, 2) AS `중앙값 초과 비율(%)`,
    under_or_equal_median_count AS `중앙값 이하 세션 수`,

    multiIf(
      platform = '전체', 0,
      platform = '웹', 1,
      platform = 'IOS', 2,
      platform = 'AOS', 3,
      4
    ) AS sort_order
  FROM
  (
    SELECT
      '전체' AS platform,

      countIf(duration_sec > (SELECT global_mean_sec FROM global_stats)) AS over_mean_count,
      countIf(duration_sec <= (SELECT global_mean_sec FROM global_stats)) AS under_or_equal_mean_count,

      countIf(duration_sec > (SELECT global_median_sec FROM global_stats)) AS over_median_count,
      countIf(duration_sec <= (SELECT global_median_sec FROM global_stats)) AS under_or_equal_median_count,

      count() AS total_sessions
    FROM filtered

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      platform_group AS platform,

      countIf(duration_sec > (SELECT global_mean_sec FROM global_stats)) AS over_mean_count,
      countIf(duration_sec <= (SELECT global_mean_sec FROM global_stats)) AS under_or_equal_mean_count,

      countIf(duration_sec > (SELECT global_median_sec FROM global_stats)) AS over_median_count,
      countIf(duration_sec <= (SELECT global_median_sec FROM global_stats)) AS under_or_equal_median_count,

      count() AS total_sessions
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY platform_group
  )
)
ORDER BY sort_order ASC;

spec.refId: 1-6. 체류시간 기준 초과/이하 세션 비중 (Session Duration Above/Below Benchmark)

spec.title: 3-1. 페이지별 세션당 평균 조회수(Pages by Views per Session)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
page_summary AS (
  SELECT
    if(page_title = '', event_name, page_title) AS page_title_name,
    page_url AS page_url,
    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS total_pv,
    countDistinctIf(session_id, event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS view_sessions,
    countDistinctIf(user_id, event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS unique_users,
    round(
      countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW')
      / nullIf(countDistinctIf(session_id, event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'), 0),
      2
    ) AS avg_pv_per_session
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND page_url != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY
    page_title_name,
    page_url
),

ordered_pages AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM page_summary
  WHERE view_sessions > 5
  ORDER BY
    avg_pv_per_session DESC,
    total_pv DESC
)

SELECT
  rowNumberInAllBlocks() + 1 AS `순번`,
  page_title_name AS `페이지 제목`,
  page_url AS `페이지 URL`,
  total_pv AS `총 PV`,
  view_sessions AS `조회 세션 수`,
  unique_users AS `순방문자 수`,
  avg_pv_per_session AS `세션당 평균 PV`
FROM ordered_pages;

spec.title: 2-6. 유저 세션별 페이지 이동 경로 (User Session Page Journey)_개인 전용

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    session_id,
    enter_time AS "진입 시간 (Enter)",
    exit_time AS "이탈 시간 (Exit)",
    multiIf(
      total_duration_sec < 60,
        concat(toString(total_duration_sec), '초'),
      total_duration_sec < 3600,
        concat(
          toString(intDiv(total_duration_sec, 60)), '분 ',
          toString(modulo(total_duration_sec, 60)), '초'
        ),
      concat(
        toString(intDiv(total_duration_sec, 3600)), '시간 ',
        toString(intDiv(modulo(total_duration_sec, 3600), 60)), '분 ',
        toString(modulo(total_duration_sec, 60)), '초'
      )
    ) AS "세션 총 체류시간 (Total Duration)",
    arrayStringConcat(
      groupArray(concat(page_title, ' (', page_duration_text, ')')),
      ' ➔ '
    ) AS "페이지별 체류 흐름 상세 (Timeline Flow)",
    arrayStringConcat(
      groupArray(page_url),
      ' \n➔ '
    ) AS "URL 이동 경로 (URL Path)"
FROM (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        client_ts,
        min(client_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS enter_time,
        max(client_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS exit_time,
        dateDiff(
          'second',
          min(client_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id),
          max(client_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id)
        ) AS total_duration_sec,
        if(empty(page_title), 'Unknown Page', page_title) AS page_title,
        page_url,
        page_duration_sec,
        multiIf(
          page_duration_sec < 60,
            concat(toString(page_duration_sec), '초'),
          page_duration_sec < 3600,
            concat(
              toString(intDiv(page_duration_sec, 60)), '분 ',
              toString(modulo(page_duration_sec, 60)), '초'
            ),
          concat(
            toString(intDiv(page_duration_sec, 3600)), '시간 ',
            toString(intDiv(modulo(page_duration_sec, 3600), 60)), '분 ',
            toString(modulo(page_duration_sec, 60)), '초'
          )
        ) AS page_duration_text
    FROM (
        SELECT
            session_id,
            client_ts,
            page_title,
            page_url,
            dateDiff(
              'second',
              client_ts,
              leadInFrame(client_ts, 1, client_ts) OVER (
                PARTITION BY session_id
                ORDER BY client_ts ASC
                ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
              )
            ) AS page_duration_sec
        FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
        WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
          AND user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
          AND session_id != ''
          AND page_url != ''
        ORDER BY session_id, client_ts ASC
    )
)
GROUP BY
    session_id,
    enter_time,
    exit_time,
    total_duration_sec
ORDER BY "진입 시간 (Enter)" DESC

spec.title: 2-2. 고객 타입별 누적 회원 현황 (Cumulative Members by Customer Type)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
  target_date AS (
    SELECT
      today() AS stat_date
  ),

  type_spine AS (
    SELECT
      number AS type_id
    FROM numbers(64)
  ),

  type_summary AS (
    SELECT
      t.type_id AS type_id,

      countDistinctIf(
        p.user_id,
        p.user_id != ''
      ) AS cumulative_count,

      countDistinctIf(
        p.user_id,
        p.user_id != ''
        AND toDate(p.profile_updated_ts) = d.stat_date
      ) AS today_change_count

    FROM type_spine AS t
    CROSS JOIN target_date AS d
    LEFT JOIN mcap_ods.user_profiles AS p
      ON p.type_id = t.type_id
    GROUP BY
      t.type_id
  ),

  total_summary AS (
    SELECT
      sum(cumulative_count) AS total_cumulative_count,
      sum(today_change_count) AS total_today_change_count
    FROM type_summary
  )

SELECT
  "고객 타입([1]본식 [2]촬영 [3]스드메 [4]웨딩홀 [5]혼수 [6]본식상품)",
  "오늘 타입 상태 업데이트된 고객 수",
  "누적 수",
  "비중"
FROM
(
  SELECT
    0 AS sort_order,
    '합계' AS "고객 타입([1]본식 [2]촬영 [3]스드메 [4]웨딩홀 [5]혼수 [6]본식상품)",
    total_today_change_count AS "오늘 타입 상태 업데이트된 고객 수",
    total_cumulative_count AS "누적 수",
    100.00 AS "비중"
  FROM total_summary

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    s.type_id + 1 AS sort_order,
    CASE
  WHEN s.type_id = 0 THEN 'T1: NNNNNN_신규/완전 탐색형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 1 THEN 'T2: NNNNNY_본식상품 단독 유입형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 2 THEN 'T3: NNNNYN_혼수 단독 계약형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 3 THEN 'T4: NNNNYY_혼수+본식상품 선계약형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 4 THEN 'T5: NNNYNN_웨딩홀 단독 계약형'

  WHEN s.type_id = 7 THEN 'T8: NNNYYY_스드메 미정/외 확정형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 8 THEN 'T9: NNYNNN_스드메 선계약형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 9 THEN 'T10: NNYNNY_스드메+본식상품 확정형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 10 THEN 'T11: NNYNYN_스드메+혼수 확정형'
  WHEN s.type_id = 11 THEN 'T12: NNYNYY_홀 미정/외 확정형'

  WHEN s.type_id = 13 THEN 'T14: NNYYNY_혼수 미정/외 확정형'

spec.title: 2-1. 고객 유형 파이프라인 비중 변화 (Customer Type Pipeline Share Trend)
spec.description:
profile_updated_ts 기준 업데이트일마다 고객 유형별 비중 변화를 보여줍니다.
각 시점의 고객 유형은 해당 업데이트일까지 저장된 최신 type_id를 기준으로 계산합니다.
현재는 주요 기준일이 2026-05-29와 2026-06-17이므로, 두 시점 간 고객 유형 파이프라인 변화 비교 용도로 해석합니다.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
update_dates AS (
  SELECT
    toDate(profile_updated_ts) AS stat_date
  FROM mcap_ods.user_profiles
  WHERE user_id != ''
    AND user_id != 'anonymous'
    AND type_id BETWEEN 0 AND 63
    AND $__timeFilter(profile_updated_ts)
  GROUP BY stat_date
  HAVING countDistinct(user_id) >= 100
),

type_spine AS (
  SELECT
    number AS profile_type_id,
    number + 1 AS type_no
  FROM numbers(64)
),

type_labels AS (
  SELECT
    type_id,
    any(segment_name_ko) AS segment_name_ko
  FROM mcap_ods.segment_mapping FINAL
  GROUP BY type_id
),

date_type_spine AS (
  SELECT
    d.stat_date AS stat_date,
    t.profile_type_id AS profile_type_id,
    t.type_no AS type_no
  FROM update_dates d
  CROSS JOIN type_spine t
),

user_type_asof AS (
  SELECT
    d.stat_date AS stat_date,
    p.user_id AS user_id,
    argMax(p.type_id, p.profile_updated_ts) AS type_id
  FROM update_dates d
  INNER JOIN mcap_ods.user_profiles p
    ON toDate(p.profile_updated_ts) <= d.stat_date
  WHERE p.user_id != ''
    AND p.user_id != 'anonymous'
    AND p.type_id BETWEEN 0 AND 63
  GROUP BY
    d.stat_date,
    p.user_id
),

daily_type_summary AS (
  SELECT
    stat_date,
    type_id,
    countDistinct(user_id) AS user_count
  FROM user_type_asof
  WHERE type_id BETWEEN 0 AND 63
  GROUP BY
    stat_date,
    type_id
),

daily_total AS (
  SELECT
    stat_date,
    sum(user_count) AS total_users
  FROM daily_type_summary
  GROUP BY stat_date
),

final_table AS (
  SELECT
    s.stat_date AS stat_date,
    s.profile_type_id AS profile_type_id,
    s.type_no AS type_no,

    concat(
      'T',
      toString(s.type_no),
      ' - ',
      ifNull(tl.segment_name_ko, '')
    ) AS type_display_name,

    ifNull(dts.user_count, 0) AS user_count,
    ifNull(dt.total_users, 0) AS total_users,

    round(
      ifNull(dts.user_count, 0)
      / nullIf(dt.total_users, 0)
      * 100,
      4
    ) AS share_percent

  FROM date_type_spine s

  LEFT JOIN daily_type_summary dts
    ON s.stat_date = dts.stat_date
   AND s.profile_type_id = dts.type_id

  LEFT JOIN daily_total dt
    ON s.stat_date = dt.stat_date

  LEFT JOIN type_labels tl
    ON s.type_no = tl.type_id
),

latest_date AS (
  SELECT
    max(stat_date) AS max_stat_date
  FROM final_table
),

latest_share AS (
  SELECT
    profile_type_id,
    max(share_percent) AS latest_share_percent
  FROM final_table
  WHERE stat_date = (SELECT max_stat_date FROM latest_date)
  GROUP BY profile_type_id
)

SELECT
  toDateTime(ft.stat_date) AS time,
  ft.type_display_name AS metric,
  ft.share_percent AS value
FROM final_table ft
LEFT JOIN latest_share ls
  ON ft.profile_type_id = ls.profile_type_id
WHERE ft.total_users > 0
ORDER BY
  time ASC,
  ls.latest_share_percent DESC,
  ft.profile_type_id ASC;

spec.title: 1-2. 플랫폼별 평균 세션 체류시간 (Average Session Duration by Platform)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
session_base AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    multiIf(
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb'), '웹',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) = 'ios', 'IOS',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('aos', 'android'), 'AOS',
      '기타'
    ) AS platform_group,
    dateDiff('second', min(client_ts), max(client_ts)) AS duration_sec
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
),

valid_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM session_base
  WHERE platform_group IN ('웹', 'IOS', 'AOS')
),

platform_rows AS (
  SELECT
    platform_group AS platform,

    sum(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec,

    round(avgIf(duration_sec, duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 1800), 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
    quantileIf(0.5)(duration_sec, duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 1800) AS median_duration_sec,

    round(
      sum(duration_sec)
      / nullIf((SELECT sum(duration_sec) FROM valid_sessions), 0)
      * 100,
      2
    ) AS duration_percent
  FROM valid_sessions
  GROUP BY platform_group
),

total_row AS (
  SELECT
    '전체' AS platform,

    sum(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec,

    round(avgIf(duration_sec, duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 1800), 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
    quantileIf(0.5)(duration_sec, duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 1800) AS median_duration_sec,

    100.00 AS duration_percent
  FROM valid_sessions
)

SELECT
  platform,
  total_duration_sec,
  avg_duration_sec,
  median_duration_sec,
  duration_percent
FROM
(
  SELECT * FROM total_row
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM platform_rows
)
ORDER BY multiIf(
  platform = '전체', 0,
  platform = '웹', 1,
  platform = 'IOS', 2,
  platform = 'AOS', 3,
  4
);

spec.title: 4-6. 검색 결과 품질 지표 (Search Result Quality Metrics)
spec.description:
검색 수 높음 + 무결과율 높음 = 검색 매칭 개선 필요
검색 수 높음 + 클릭률 낮음 = 결과는 나오지만 매력도/정확도 낮음
검색 수 높음 + 클릭률 높음 = 유효한 검색 니즈

spec.rawSql:
WITH
search_events AS (
  SELECT
    cityHash64(
      session_id,
      toString(client_ts),
      user_id,
      JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_category'),
      JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_keyword')
    ) AS search_key,

    user_id,
    session_id,

    JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_category') AS search_category,
    JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_keyword') AS search_keyword,

    greatest(
      JSONExtractUInt(properties_json, 'search_result_count'),
      toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_result_count'))
    ) AS search_result_count

  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND event_type = 'SEARCH'
    AND session_id != ''
    AND JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_keyword') != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
),

click_events AS (
  SELECT
    client_ts AS click_ts,
    session_id
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      event_type IN ('SEARCH_RESULT_CLICK', 'PRODUCT_CLICK')
      OR JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_result_product_id') != ''
    )
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
),

search_with_clicks AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_key,
    s.search_category,
    s.search_keyword,
    s.user_id,
    s.session_id,
    s.search_result_count,

    countIf(c.click_ts >= s.search_ts) AS product_click_count,

    if(countIf(c.click_ts >= s.search_ts) > 0, 1, 0) AS has_product_click

  FROM search_events s
  LEFT JOIN click_events c
    ON s.session_id = c.session_id

  GROUP BY
    s.search_key,
    s.search_category,
    s.search_keyword,
    s.user_id,
    s.session_id,
    s.search_result_count
)

SELECT
  if(search_category = '', '카테고리 미확인', search_category) AS `검색 카테고리`,

  count() AS `검색 수`,
  countDistinct(user_id) AS `검색 유저 수`,
  countDistinct(session_id) AS `검색 세션 수`,

  round(avg(search_result_count), 2) AS `평균 검색 결과 수`,

  countIf(search_result_count = 0) AS `무결과 수`,
  round(countIf(search_result_count = 0) / nullIf(count(), 0) * 100, 2) AS `무결과율(%)`,

  sum(has_product_click) AS `상품 클릭 발생 검색 수`,
  round(sum(has_product_click) / nullIf(count(), 0) * 100, 2) AS `검색 후 상품 클릭률(%)`,

  sum(product_click_count) AS `상품 클릭 수`,
  round(sum(product_click_count) / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS `검색당 평균 상품 클릭 수`

FROM search_with_clicks
GROUP BY search_category
ORDER BY
  `검색 수` DESC;

spec.title: 4-8. 스크랩 상태 요약 (Scrap Status Summary)
spec.description:
콘텐츠 스크랩 클릭 이벤트를 기준으로 스크랩 추가와 해제 비중을 집계합니다.
PAGE_VIEW성 스크랩 노출 이벤트는 제외하고, 실제 CLICK 이벤트의 status 값만 기준으로 계산합니다.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scrap_events AS (
  SELECT
    multiIf(
      JSONExtractBool(properties_json, 'status') = 1, '스크랩 추가',
      JSONExtractBool(properties_json, 'status') = 0, '스크랩 해제',

  WHERE $__timeFilter(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND event_type = 'CLICK'
    AND event_name = '콘텐츠 스크랩'
    AND JSONHas(properties_json, 'status')
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )

summary AS (
  SELECT
    scrap_status,
    count() AS scrap_click_count,
    countDistinct(user_id) AS scrap_user_count,
    countDistinct(session_id) AS scrap_session_count
  FROM scrap_events
  GROUP BY scrap_status

total AS (

  FROM summary

SELECT

  scrap_click_count AS `클릭 수`,

  scrap_user_count AS `유저 수`,
  scrap_session_count AS `세션 수`
FROM summary
CROSS JOIN total

      '기타 화면'
    ) AS scrap_source_page_type,

latest_by_user_page AS (

    max(client_ts) AS latest_event_ts
  FROM scrap_events
  GROUP BY

    scrap_source_page_type,
    source_page_id

SELECT

    latest_status = 1, '현재 스크랩 유지',

  max(latest_event_ts) AS `최근 변경 시각`

  SELECT
    *
  FROM base
  WHERE platform_group IN ('웹', 'IOS', 'AOS')
),

platform_rows AS (
  SELECT
    platform_group AS platform,
    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS pv_count,
    countDistinct(session_id) AS sessions,
    round(
      countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW')
      / nullIf(countDistinct(session_id), 0),
      2
    ) AS avg_pv_per_session,
    round(
      countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW')
      / nullIf(
          (
            SELECT countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW')
            FROM valid_base
          ),
          0
        )
      * 100,
      2
    ) AS pv_percent
  FROM valid_base
  GROUP BY platform_group
),

total_row AS (
  SELECT
    '전체' AS platform,
    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS pv_count,
    countDistinct(session_id) AS sessions,
    round(
      countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW')
      / nullIf(countDistinct(session_id), 0),
      2
    ) AS avg_pv_per_session,
    100.00 AS pv_percent
  FROM valid_base
)

SELECT
  platform,
  pv_count,
  sessions,
  avg_pv_per_session,
  pv_percent
FROM
(
  SELECT
    platform,
    pv_count,
    sessions,
    avg_pv_per_session,
    pv_percent
  FROM total_row

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    platform,
    pv_count,
    sessions,
    avg_pv_per_session,
    pv_percent
  FROM platform_rows
)
ORDER BY multiIf(
  platform = '전체', 0,
  platform = '웹', 1,
  platform = 'IOS', 2,
  platform = 'AOS', 3,
  4
);

spec.title: 1-5. 플랫폼별 세션 체류시간 분포 (Session Duration Distribution by Platform)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
session_base AS (
  SELECT
    argMax(user_id, client_ts) AS session_user_id,
    session_id,
    multiIf(
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('web', 'pc', 'mobile_web', 'mweb'), '웹',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) = 'ios', 'IOS',
      lower(argMax(platform, client_ts)) IN ('aos', 'android'), 'AOS',
      '기타'
    ) AS platform_group,
    dateDiff('second', min(client_ts), max(client_ts)) AS duration_sec
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY session_id
),

filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM session_base
  WHERE platform_group IN ('웹', 'IOS', 'AOS')
    AND duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 10800
)

SELECT
  platform,
  valid_sessions,
  mean_sec,
  median_sec,
  standard_deviation_sec,
  p75_sec,
  p90_sec,
  maximum_sec
FROM
(
  SELECT
    '전체' AS platform,
    count() AS valid_sessions,
    round(avg(duration_sec), 2) AS mean_sec,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_sec) AS median_sec,
    round(stddevPop(duration_sec), 2) AS standard_deviation_sec,
    quantile(0.75)(duration_sec) AS p75_sec,
    quantile(0.9)(duration_sec) AS p90_sec,
    max(duration_sec) AS maximum_sec
  FROM filtered

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    platform_group AS platform,
    count() AS valid_sessions,
    round(avg(duration_sec), 2) AS mean_sec,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_sec) AS median_sec,
    round(stddevPop(duration_sec), 2) AS standard_deviation_sec,
    quantile(0.75)(duration_sec) AS p75_sec,
    quantile(0.9)(duration_sec) AS p90_sec,
    max(duration_sec) AS maximum_sec
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY platform_group
)
ORDER BY multiIf(
  platform = '전체', 0,
  platform = '웹', 1,
  platform = 'IOS', 2,
  platform = 'AOS', 3,
  4
);

spec.title: 2-4. 유저 마스터 정보 (Status Profile)

spec.rawSql:
WITH
profile AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    contract_status_mask,
    type_id,
    profile_updated_ts,
    wedding_date_planned
  FROM mcap_ods.user_profiles FINAL
),

behavior AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    countDistinct(session_id) AS total_sessions,
    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS total_page_views,
    countIf(event_type = 'SEARCH') AS total_searches,
    countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CLICK') AS total_product_clicks,
    min(client_ts) AS first_seen_at,
    max(client_ts) AS last_seen_at,
    argMax(platform, client_ts) AS preferred_platform
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY user_id
),

session_duration AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    round(avg(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_session_duration_sec
  FROM (
    SELECT
      user_id,
      session_id,
      dateDiff('second', min(client_ts), max(client_ts)) AS duration_sec
    FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
    WHERE session_id != ''
      AND (
        '${Search_UserID}' = ''
        OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
        OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
      )
    GROUP BY user_id, session_id
  )
  WHERE duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 10800
  GROUP BY user_id
),

final_table AS (
  SELECT
    p.user_id AS user_id,
    p.contract_status_mask AS contract_status_mask,
    p.type_id AS type_id,

    ifNull(b.total_sessions, 0) AS total_sessions,
    ifNull(b.total_page_views, 0) AS total_page_views,

    round(
      ifNull(b.total_page_views, 0)
      / nullIf(ifNull(b.total_sessions, 0), 0),
      2
    ) AS avg_pv_per_session,

    ifNull(s.avg_session_duration_sec, 0) AS avg_session_duration_sec,
    ifNull(b.total_searches, 0) AS total_searches,
    ifNull(b.total_product_clicks, 0) AS total_product_clicks,

    p.profile_updated_ts AS profile_updated_ts,

    b.first_seen_at AS first_seen_at,
    b.last_seen_at AS last_seen_at,

    ifNull(b.preferred_platform, '') AS preferred_platform,
    p.wedding_date_planned AS wedding_date_planned

  FROM profile p
  LEFT JOIN behavior b
    ON p.user_id = b.user_id
  LEFT JOIN session_duration s
    ON p.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE (
    '${Search_UserID}' = ''
    OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
    OR p.user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
  )
),

ordered_table AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM final_table
  ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
)

SELECT
  rowNumberInAllBlocks() + 1 AS `순번`,
  user_id AS `유저 ID`,
  contract_status_mask AS `계약 상태`,
  type_id AS `유형 ID`,
  total_sessions AS `총 세션 수`,
  total_page_views AS `총 PV`,
  avg_pv_per_session AS `세션당 평균 PV`,
  avg_session_duration_sec AS `평균 세션 체류시간`,
  total_searches AS `검색 수`,
  total_product_clicks AS `상품 클릭 수`,
  profile_updated_ts AS `프로필 업데이트 시각`,
  first_seen_at AS `최초 방문 시각`,
  last_seen_at AS `마지막 방문 시각`,
  preferred_platform AS `주 이용 플랫폼`,
  wedding_date_planned AS `예정 예식일`
FROM ordered_table;

spec.title: 2-5. 개인 행동 기반 추천 후보 (Behavior-based Recommendation Candidates)_개인 전용
spec.description:
선택한 유저의 최근 행동 로그를 기반으로 관심 카테고리와 관심 상품 후보를 산출합니다.
점수는 100점 만점이며, 페이지뷰·검색·카테고리 진입·상품 클릭·체류시간·최근성을 반영합니다.
상품 식별값이 TEMP_로 시작하는 경우, 로그에 상품ID가 없어 event_name을 기준으로 임시 생성한 값입니다.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    client_ts,
    event_type,
    event_name,
    page_title,
    page_url,
    properties_json,

    JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_category') AS search_category,
    JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_keyword') AS search_keyword,
    JSONExtractString(properties_json, 'search_result_product_id') AS product_id,

    multiIf(
      event_name ILIKE '%웨딩홀%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%웨딩홀%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%웨딩홀%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%웨딩홀%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%컨벤션%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%채플%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%호텔%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%빌라드%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%노블%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%아펠가모%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%더채플%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%루이비스%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%라루체%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%아이벡스%',
        '웨딩홀',

      event_name ILIKE '%스튜디오%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%스튜디오%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%스튜디오%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%스튜디오%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%studio%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%피아%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%로라%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%해밀%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%비마이%',
        '스튜디오',

      event_name ILIKE '%드레스%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%드레스%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%드레스%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%드레스%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%브라이드%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%브라이덜%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%클라라%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%로리에%',
        '드레스',

      event_name ILIKE '%헤어%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%메이크업%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%메이크%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%뷰티%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%헤어%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%메이크업%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%헤어%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%메이크업%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%헤어%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%메이크업%',
        '헤어·메이크업',

      event_name ILIKE '%혼수%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%혼수%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%혼수%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%혼수%',
        '혼수',

      event_name ILIKE '%본식%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%본식%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%본식%'
        OR search_category ILIKE '%본식%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%부케%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%dvd%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%영상%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%부케%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%dvd%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%영상%',
        '본식상품',

      event_name ILIKE '%스냅%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%스냅%'
        OR search_keyword ILIKE '%스냅%',
        '스냅',

      event_name ILIKE '%쿠폰%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%쿠폰%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%혜택%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%혜택%'
        OR event_name ILIKE '%페이백%'
        OR page_title ILIKE '%페이백%',
        '혜택',

      product_id != '',
        '관심상품',

      '기타'
    ) AS category

  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
),

page_flow AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    greatest(
      0,
      least(
        dateDiff(
          'second',
          client_ts,
          leadInFrame(client_ts, 1, client_ts) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id, session_id
            ORDER BY client_ts ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
          )
        ),
        600
      )
    ) AS stay_sec
  FROM base
),

category_raw AS (
  SELECT
    category,

    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS page_views,
    countIf(event_type = 'SEARCH') AS searches,
    countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CATEGORY') AS category_views,
    countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CLICK') AS product_clicks,
    countIf(product_id != '') AS product_id_actions,
    round(sum(stay_sec) / 60, 2) AS stay_minutes,

    round(
      least(countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') * 5, 25)
      + least(countIf(event_type = 'SEARCH') * 5, 15)
      + least(countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CATEGORY') * 10, 20)
      + least(countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CLICK') * 12.5, 25)
      + least((sum(stay_sec) / 60) * 3, 15),
      2
    ) AS category_interest_100

  FROM page_flow
  WHERE category != '기타'
  GROUP BY category
),

item_raw AS (
  SELECT
    category,

    if(
      product_id != '',
      product_id,
      concat('TEMP_', replaceRegexpAll(event_name, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣_ -]', ''))
    ) AS item_key,

    if(
      product_id != '',
      '로그 상품ID',
      '임시ID'
    ) AS item_id_type,

    if(
      event_name != '',
      event_name,
      if(product_id != '', concat('상품ID ', product_id), '상품명 없음')
    ) AS item_name,

    anyLast(search_keyword) AS last_search_keyword,
    anyLast(search_category) AS last_search_category,

    count() AS item_total_actions,
    countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CLICK') AS item_product_clicks,
    countIf(product_id != '') AS item_product_id_actions,
    countIf(event_type = 'CLICK') AS item_clicks,
    countIf(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW') AS item_page_views,

    max(client_ts) AS last_item_action_at,

    multiIf(
      max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 20,
      max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY, 12,
      max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY, 5,
      0
    ) AS recency_score,

    round(
      least(countIf(event_type = 'PRODUCT_CLICK') * 20, 40)
      + least(countIf(product_id != '') * 12.5, 25)
      + least(countIf(event_type = 'CLICK') * 5, 15)
      + multiIf(
          max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 20,
          max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY, 12,
          max(client_ts) >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY, 5,
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS item_interest_100

  FROM page_flow
  WHERE category != '기타'
    AND (
      product_id != ''
      OR event_type IN ('PRODUCT_CLICK', 'CLICK', 'SEARCH_RESULT_CLICK')
    )
    AND event_name != ''
  GROUP BY
    category,
    item_key,
    item_id_type,
    item_name
),

ranked_items AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY category
      ORDER BY item_interest_100 DESC, last_item_action_at DESC
    ) AS item_rank
  FROM item_raw
),

final_table AS (
  SELECT
    cs.category AS category,
    cs.category_interest_100 AS category_interest_100,

    multiIf(
      cs.category_interest_100 >= 80, '매우 높음',
      cs.category_interest_100 >= 60, '높음',
      cs.category_interest_100 >= 40, '보통',
      cs.category_interest_100 >= 20, '낮음',
      '매우 낮음'
    ) AS category_interest_level,

    ri.item_name AS item_name,
    ri.item_key AS item_key,
    ri.item_id_type AS item_id_type,
    ri.item_interest_100 AS item_interest_100,

    multiIf(
      ri.item_interest_100 >= 80, '매우 높음',
      ri.item_interest_100 >= 60, '높음',
      ri.item_interest_100 >= 40, '보통',
      ri.item_interest_100 >= 20, '낮음',
      '매우 낮음'
    ) AS item_interest_level,

    cs.page_views AS page_views,
    cs.searches AS searches,
    cs.category_views AS category_views,
    cs.product_clicks AS product_clicks,
    cs.product_id_actions AS product_id_actions,
    cs.stay_minutes AS stay_minutes,

    ri.item_total_actions AS item_total_actions,
    ri.item_product_clicks AS item_product_clicks,
    ri.item_product_id_actions AS item_product_id_actions,
    ri.item_clicks AS item_clicks,
    ri.recency_score AS recency_score,

    ri.last_search_keyword AS last_search_keyword,
    ri.last_search_category AS last_search_category,
    ri.last_item_action_at AS last_item_action_at

  FROM category_raw cs
  LEFT JOIN ranked_items ri
    ON cs.category = ri.category
   AND ri.item_rank = 1
)

SELECT
  row_number() OVER (
    ORDER BY category_interest_100 DESC, item_interest_100 DESC
  ) AS `추천 순위`,

  category AS `추천 카테고리`,
  category_interest_100 AS `카테고리 관심도(100점)`,
  category_interest_level AS `카테고리 관심 수준`,

  item_name AS `관심 상품 후보`,
  item_key AS `상품 식별값`,
  item_id_type AS `식별값 유형`,
  item_interest_100 AS `상품 관심도(100점)`,
  item_interest_level AS `상품 관심 수준`,

  page_views AS `카테고리 PV`,
  searches AS `검색 수`,
  category_views AS `카테고리 진입 수`,
  product_clicks AS `상품 클릭 수`,
  product_id_actions AS `상품ID 포함 행동 수`,
  stay_minutes AS `카테고리 체류시간(분)`,

  item_total_actions AS `상품 관련 행동 수`,
  item_product_clicks AS `상품 클릭 행동 수`,
  item_product_id_actions AS `상품ID 행동 수`,
  item_clicks AS `일반 클릭 수`,
  recency_score AS `최근성 점수`,

  last_search_keyword AS `최근 검색어`,
  last_search_category AS `최근 검색 카테고리`,
  last_item_action_at AS `마지막 관심 시각`

FROM final_table
ORDER BY
  `추천 순위` ASC
LIMIT 5;

spec.title: 1-3. 시간별 활성 세션 추이 (Traffic Trend)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(session_start) AS time,
  count() AS "활성 세션 수"
FROM (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    min(client_ts) AS session_start
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

spec.title: 3-2. 진입/이탈 페이지 분석 (Entry & Exit)

spec.rawSql:
WITH session_pages AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    argMin(page_url, client_ts) AS entry_page,
    argMin(page_title, client_ts) AS entry_page_title,
    argMax(page_url, client_ts) AS exit_page,
    argMax(page_title, client_ts) AS exit_page_title
  FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
    AND session_id != ''
    AND page_url != ''
    AND (
      '${Search_UserID}' = ''
      OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
      OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
    )
  GROUP BY
    session_id
)

SELECT
  page_title AS "페이지 제목",
  page_url AS "페이지 URL",
  sum(is_entry) AS "진입 수",
  sum(is_exit) AS "이탈 수",
  sum(is_entry) + sum(is_exit) AS "총 진입/이탈 수"
FROM (
  SELECT
    entry_page_title AS page_title,
    entry_page AS page_url,
    1 AS is_entry,
    0 AS is_exit
  FROM session_pages
  WHERE entry_page != ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    exit_page_title AS page_title,
    exit_page AS page_url,
    0 AS is_entry,
    1 AS is_exit
  FROM session_pages
  WHERE exit_page != ''
)
GROUP BY
  page_title,
  page_url
ORDER BY "총 진입/이탈 수" DESC
LIMIT 30

spec.title: 4-1. 이벤트 유형별 발생 수 (Event Type Distribution)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE event_type
    WHEN 'PAGE_VIEW' THEN '페이지 조회'
    WHEN 'BUTTON_CLICK' THEN '버튼 클릭'
    WHEN 'PRODUCT_CLICK' THEN '상품 클릭'
    WHEN 'SEARCH' THEN '검색'
    WHEN 'CONTENT_COMMENT' THEN '콘텐츠 댓글'
    WHEN 'PRODUCT_CATEGORY' THEN '상품 카테고리'
    WHEN 'SEARCH_RESULT_CLICK' THEN '검색 결과 클릭'
    WHEN 'CLICK' THEN '일반 클릭'
    WHEN 'IMAGE_CLICK' THEN '이미지 클릭'
    WHEN 'CONTENT_SHARE' THEN '콘텐츠 공유'
    WHEN 'CONTENT_LIKE' THEN '콘텐츠 좋아요'
    ELSE event_type
  END AS "이벤트 유형",
  count() AS "이벤트 수",
  countDistinct(user_id) AS "유저 수",
  countDistinct(session_id) AS "세션 수",
  round(count() / nullIf(sum(count()) OVER (), 0) * 100, 2) AS "이벤트 비중"
FROM mcap_ods.behavior_events
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(client_ts)
  AND (
    '${Search_UserID}' = ''
    OR '${Search_UserID}' = 'All'
    OR user_id = '${Search_UserID}'
  )
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY "이벤트 수" DESC;
